levels.surface: عبادة بن الوليد بن عبادة بن الصامت

notes: The chain is written to ʿUbāda; «- وتقاربا في لفظ الحديث -» and «والسياق لهارون» are remarks and are left out
«خرجت أنا وأبي» : the father is a companion on the journey, not a link

Rule 6 case: the text then narrates encounters with Abu al-Yusr and Jabir ibn Abdullah, each speaking and quoting the Prophet; which of them is the last link is not settled by the rules, so this is flagged rather than decided
